source.title: TakeProfit manual testing parts 1-3
source.confidence_boundary: The report text supports historical occurrence and reproduction descriptions. Original screenshots and console exports are not digest-bound in this repository.

findings.title: IndicatorManager required-field errors and undefined.info during chart reload
signatures: IndicatorManager selected is a required field
indicators is a required field
version is a required field
Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'info')
findings.trigger: select ticker, add or remove indicators, reload the page

findings.title: IndicatorManager validation errors while adding a published indicator
signatures: IndicatorManager selected is a required field
indicators is a required field
version is a required field
indicator ID is a required field
calculation.args is a required field
display is a required field
findings.trigger: open published indicator and choose Add to Chart

findings.title: ChartStore crosshair settings missing during indicator-page initialization
signatures: settings.chart.style.crosshairStyle is a required field
settings.chart.style.crosshairWidth is a required field
findings.trigger: load published indicator page and inspect console

findings.title: Multiple required-field errors during workspace creation
signatures: IndicatorManager selected is a required field

findings.title: undefined.info after mobile-web chart reload
signatures: Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'info')
